107        public static enum RaidDangerLevel {
108                NONE("None", "None", Misc.getPositiveHighlightColor(), 0f, 60f, 1),
109                MINIMAL("Minimal", "Minimal", Misc.getPositiveHighlightColor(), 0.02f, 50f, 1),
110                LOW("Low", "Light", Misc.getPositiveHighlightColor(), 0.04f, 40f, 2),
111                MEDIUM("Medium", "Moderate", Misc.getHighlightColor(), 0.08f, 30f, 3),
112                HIGH("High", "Heavy", Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor(), 0.16f, 20f, 5),
113                EXTREME("Extreme", "Extreme", Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor(), 0.32f, 10f, 7);
114                
115                private static RaidDangerLevel [] vals = values();
116                
117                public String name;
118                public String lossesName;
119                public Color color;
120                public float marineLossesMult;
121                public int marineTokens;
122                public float disruptionDays;
123                private RaidDangerLevel(String name, String lossesName, Color color, float marineLossesMult, float disruptionDays, int marineTokens) {
124                        this.name = name;
125                        this.lossesName = lossesName;
126                        this.color = color;
127                        this.marineLossesMult = marineLossesMult;
128                        this.disruptionDays = disruptionDays;
129                        this.marineTokens = marineTokens;
130                }
131                
132                public RaidDangerLevel next() {
133                        int index = this.ordinal() + 1;
134                        if (index >= vals.length) index = vals.length - 1;
135                        return vals[index];
136                }
137                public RaidDangerLevel prev() {
138                        int index = this.ordinal() - 1;
139                        if (index < 0) index = 0;
140                        return vals[index];
141                }
142        }

276        protected void init(SectorEntityToken entity) {
277                
278                memory = entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
279                this.entity = entity;
280                playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
281                playerCargo = playerFleet.getCargo();
282                
283                playerFaction = Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction();
284                entityFaction = entity.getFaction();
285                
286                faction = entity.getFaction();
287                
288                market = entity.getMarket();
289                
290                //DebugFlags.MARKET_HOSTILITIES_DEBUG = false;
291                //market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PLAYER_HOSTILE_ACTIVITY_NEAR_MARKET, true, 0.1f);
292                
293                String key = "$MarketCMD_temp";
294                MemoryAPI mem = null;
295                if (market != null) {
296                        mem = market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
297                } else {
298                        mem = entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
299                }
300                if (mem.contains(key)) {
301                        temp = (TempData) mem.get(key);
302                } else {
303                        mem.set(key, temp, 0f);
304                }
305        }

973        public static float getRaidStr(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
974                float attackerStr = fleet.getCargo().getMaxPersonnel() * 0.25f;
975                float support = Misc.getFleetwideTotalMod(fleet, Stats.FLEET_GROUND_SUPPORT, 0f);
976                attackerStr += Math.min(support, attackerStr);
977                
978                StatBonus stat = fleet.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PLANETARY_OPERATIONS_MOD);
979                attackerStr = stat.computeEffective(attackerStr);
980                
981                return attackerStr;
982        }
983        
984        public static float MARINES_IN_MARKET_CARGO_DEFENSE_BONUS = 1f;
985        public static float getDefenderStr(MarketAPI market) {
986                return getDefenderStr(market, false);
987        }
988        public static float getDefenderStr(MarketAPI market, boolean forBombard) {
989                StatBonus stat = market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.GROUND_DEFENSES_MOD);
990                float defenderStr = (int) Math.round(stat.computeEffective(0f));
991                float added = getDefenderIncreaseValue(market);
992                defenderStr += added;
993                
994                if (market.isPlayerOwned() && !forBombard) {
995                        float marineDefenseValueMult = MARINES_IN_MARKET_CARGO_DEFENSE_BONUS;
996                        CargoAPI cargo = Misc.getStorageCargo(market);
997                        if (cargo != null) {
998                                defenderStr += cargo.getMarines() * marineDefenseValueMult;
999                        }
1000                        cargo = Misc.getLocalResourcesCargo(market);
1001                        if (cargo != null) {
1002                                defenderStr += cargo.getMarines() * marineDefenseValueMult;
1003                        }
1004                }
1005                
1006                return defenderStr;
1007        }
1008        
1009        public static float getRaidEffectiveness(MarketAPI market, CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
1010                return getRaidEffectiveness(market, getRaidStr(fleet));
1011        }
1012        public static float getRaidEffectiveness(MarketAPI market, float attackerStr) {
1013                float defenderStr = getDefenderStr(market);
1014                return attackerStr / Math.max(1f, (attackerStr + defenderStr));
1015        }

1017        public static int getMarinesFor(MarketAPI market, int tokens) {
1018                float defenderStr = getDefenderStr(market);
1019                return getMarinesFor((int)defenderStr, tokens);
1020        }
1021        public static int getMarinesFor(int defenderStrength, int tokens) {
1022//              mult = as / (as + ds);
1023//              tokens = mult / re_per
1024//
1025//              t * re_per = as / (as + ds)
1026//              t * re_per * (as + ds) = as;
1027//              t * re_per * as + t * re_per * ds = as;
1028//              t * re_per * ds = as * (1 - t * re_per)
1029//              as = t * re_per * ds / (1 - t * re_per)
1030                
1031                
1032                int marines = (int) Math.round((float) tokens * RE_PER_MARINE_TOKEN * 
1033                                                        (float) defenderStrength / (1f - (float) tokens * RE_PER_MARINE_TOKEN));
1034                
1035                return marines;
1036        }

1038                DisruptIndustryRaidObjectivePluginImpl obj = new DisruptIndustryRaidObjectivePluginImpl(market, industry);
1039                return (int) Math.round(obj.getBaseDisruptDuration(1));
1040        }

1506        protected void addBombardConfirmOptions() {
1507                options.clearOptions();
1508                options.addOption("Launch bombardment", BOMBARD_CONFIRM);
1509                options.addOption("Never mind", BOMBARD_NEVERMIND);
1510                options.setShortcut(BOMBARD_NEVERMIND, Keyboard.KEY_ESCAPE, false, false, false, true);
1511                
1512                List<FactionAPI> nonHostile = new ArrayList<FactionAPI>();
1513                for (FactionAPI faction : temp.willBecomeHostile) {
1514                        boolean hostile = faction.isHostileTo(Factions.PLAYER);
1515                        if (!hostile) {
1516                                nonHostile.add(faction);
1517                        }
1518                }
1519                
1520                if (nonHostile.size() == 1) {
1521                        FactionAPI faction = nonHostile.get(0);
1522                        options.addOptionConfirmation(BOMBARD_CONFIRM,
1523                                        "The " + faction.getDisplayNameLong() + 
1524                                        " " + faction.getDisplayNameIsOrAre() + 
1525                                        " not currently hostile, and will become hostile if you carry out the bombardment. " +
1526                                        "Are you sure?", "Yes", "Never mind");
1527                } else if (nonHostile.size() > 1) {
1528                        options.addOptionConfirmation(BOMBARD_CONFIRM,
1529                                        "Multiple factions that are not currently hostile " +
1530                                        "will become hostile if you carry out the bombardment. " +
1531                                        "Are you sure?", "Yes", "Never mind");
1532                }
1533        }

1749        public static final String DEFENDER_INCREASE_KEY = "$core_defenderIncrease";
1750        public static float getDefenderIncreaseRaw(MarketAPI market) {
1751                if (market == null) return 0f;
1752                float e = market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getExpire(DEFENDER_INCREASE_KEY);
1753                if (e < 0) e = 0;
1754                return e;
1755        }
1756        
1757        public static void applyDefenderIncreaseFromRaid(MarketAPI market) {
1758                float e = market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getExpire(DEFENDER_INCREASE_KEY);
1759                if(e < 0) e = 0;
1760                e += getRaidDefenderIncreasePerRaid();
1761                float max = getRaidDefenderIncreaseMax();
1762                if (e > max) e = max;
1763                
1764                market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(DEFENDER_INCREASE_KEY, true);
1765                market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().expire(DEFENDER_INCREASE_KEY, e);
1766        }
1767        
1768        public static float getDefenderIncreaseValue(MarketAPI market) {
1769                float e = getDefenderIncreaseRaw(market);
1770                float f = getRaidDefenderIncreaseFraction();
1771                float min = getRaidDefenderIncreaseMin();
1772                
1773                float base = PopulationAndInfrastructure.getBaseGroundDefenses(market.getSize());
1774                float incr = Math.max(base * f, min);
1775                
1776                float per = getRaidDefenderIncreasePerRaid();
1777                
1778                return (int)(incr * e / per);
1779        }

1809        protected Random getRandom() {
1810                String key = "$raid_random";
1811                MemoryAPI mem = null;
1812                SectorEntityToken entity = null;
1813                if (market != null) {
1814                        mem = market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
1815                        entity = market.getPrimaryEntity();
1816                } else {
1817                        entity = this.entity;
1818                        mem = entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
1819                }
1820                Random random = null;
1821                if (mem.contains(key)) {
1822                        random = (Random) mem.get(key);
1823                } else {
1824                        if (entity != null) {
1825                                long seed = Misc.getSalvageSeed(entity);
1826                                seed /= 321L;
1827                                seed *= (Global.getSector().getClock().getMonth() + 10);
1828                                random = new Random(seed);
1829                        } else {
1830                                random = new Random();
1831                        }
1832                }
1833                mem.set(key, random, 30f);
1834                
1835                return random;
1836        }

1847        protected MutableStat getMarineLossesStat(List<GroundRaidObjectivePlugin> data) {
1848                MutableStat stat = new MutableStat(1f);
1849                
1850                float total = 0f;
1851                float assignedTokens = 0f;
1852                for (GroundRaidObjectivePlugin curr : data) {
1853                        RaidDangerLevel danger = curr.getDangerLevel();
1854                        total += danger.marineLossesMult * (float) curr.getMarinesAssigned();
1855                        assignedTokens += curr.getMarinesAssigned();
1856                }
1857                
1858                float danger = total / Math.max(1f, assignedTokens);
1859                
1860                float hazard = 1f;
1861                if (market != null) hazard = market.getHazardValue();
1862                
1863                float reMult = 1f;
1864                if (temp.raidMult > MIN_RE_TO_REDUCE_MARINE_LOSSES) {
1865                        float extra = (temp.raidMult - MIN_RE_TO_REDUCE_MARINE_LOSSES) / (1f - MIN_RE_TO_REDUCE_MARINE_LOSSES);
1866//                      extra = (float) Math.sqrt(extra);
1867//                      extra *= 0.5f;
1868                        extra = MAX_MARINE_LOSS_REDUCTION_MULT + (1f - MAX_MARINE_LOSS_REDUCTION_MULT) * (1f - extra);
1869                        reMult = extra;
1870                } else if (temp.raidMult < RE_PER_MARINE_TOKEN) {
1871                        float extra = 1f + (RE_PER_MARINE_TOKEN - temp.raidMult) / RE_PER_MARINE_TOKEN;
1872                        reMult = extra;
1873                }
1874                
1875                if (market != null && reMult < 1f) {
1876                        float minMarinesForAssignedTokens = getMarinesFor(market, (int) Math.round(assignedTokens));
1877                        float actualMarines = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo().getMarines();
1878                        if (actualMarines > minMarinesForAssignedTokens && actualMarines > 0) {
1879                                reMult *= 0.5f + (0.5f * minMarinesForAssignedTokens / actualMarines);
1880                        }
1881                }
1882
1883                float reservesMult = 1f;
1884                float maxTokens = getNumMarineTokens();
1885                if (maxTokens > assignedTokens) {
1886                        reservesMult = 1f - (maxTokens - assignedTokens) * LOSS_REDUCTION_PER_RESERVE_TOKEN;
1887                        reservesMult = Math.max(0.5f, reservesMult);
1888                }
1889                
1890                float e = getDefenderIncreaseRaw(market);
1891                float per = getRaidDefenderIncreasePerRaid();
1892                float prep = e / per * LOSS_INCREASE_PER_RAID;
1893                
1894                stat.modifyMultAlways("danger", danger, "Danger level of objectives");
1895                stat.modifyMult("hazard", hazard, "Colony hazard rating");
1896                if (reMult < 1f) {
1897                        stat.modifyMultAlways("reMult", reMult, "High raid effectiveness");
1898                } else if (reMult > 1f) {
1899                        stat.modifyMultAlways("reMult", reMult, "Low raid effectiveness");
1900                }
1901                
1902                if (reservesMult < 1f && assignedTokens > 0) {
1903                        stat.modifyMultAlways("reservesMult", reservesMult, "Forces held in reserve");
1904                }
1905//              else if (reservesMult >= 1f && assignedTokens > 0) {
1906//                      stat.modifyMultAlways("reservesMult", 1f, "No forces held in reserve");
1907//              }
1908                
1909                stat.modifyMult("prep", 1f + prep, "Increased defender preparedness");
1910                
1911                stat.applyMods(playerFleet.getStats().getDynamic().getStat(Stats.PLANETARY_OPERATIONS_CASUALTIES_MULT));
1912                
1913                ListenerUtil.modifyMarineLossesStatPreRaid(market, data, stat);
1914                
1915                return stat;
1916        }

1920        protected float getAverageMarineLosses(List<GroundRaidObjectivePlugin> data) {
1921                MutableStat stat = getMarineLossesStat(data);
1922                float mult = stat.getModifiedValue();
1923                if (mult > MAX_MARINE_LOSSES) {
1924                        mult = MAX_MARINE_LOSSES;
1925                }
1926                
1927                float marines = playerFleet.getCargo().getMarines();
1928                return marines * mult;
1929        }

2019                        randomizedLosses = Math.round(randomizedLosses);

2021                        
2022                        // if the losses are minor, add a chance to have no losses

2025                                        losses = 0;

2027                        }
2028                        
2029                        if (losses < 0) losses = 0;

2070                
2071//              if (!temp.nonMarket) {

2075//              }
2076                
2077                CargoAPI result = performRaid(random, temp.raidMult);

2079                if (market != null) market.reapplyIndustries();

2081                result.sort();

2084                temp.raidLoot = result;
2085

2205        protected CargoAPI performRaid(Random random, float raidEffectiveness) {
2206                CargoAPI result = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true);
2207                
2208                float leftoverRE = (int)Math.round(raidEffectiveness * 100f) % (int)Math.round(RE_PER_MARINE_TOKEN * 100f);
2209                leftoverRE /= 100f;
2210                if (raidEffectiveness < RE_PER_MARINE_TOKEN) {
2211                        //leftoverRE = leftoverRE - RE_PER_MARINE_TOKEN;
2212                        leftoverRE = 0f;
2213                }
2214                
2215                long baseSeed = random.nextLong();
2216                
2217                int xp = 0;
2218                for (GroundRaidObjectivePlugin plugin : temp.objectives) {
2219                        float lootMult = 1f + leftoverRE / Math.max(RE_PER_MARINE_TOKEN, raidEffectiveness);
2220                        
2221                        Random curr = new Random(Misc.seedUniquifier() ^ (baseSeed * plugin.getClass().getName().hashCode()));
2222                        xp += plugin.performRaid(result, curr, lootMult, dialog.getTextPanel());
2223                }
2224
2225                temp.xpGained = xp;
2226                
2227                return result;
2228        }

2384        protected CampaignFleetAPI getInteractionTargetForFIDPI() {
2385                CampaignFleetAPI primary = getStationFleet();
2386                if (primary == null) {
2387                        CampaignFleetAPI best = null;
2388                        float minDist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
2389                        for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : Misc.getNearbyFleets(entity, 2000)) {
2390                                if (fleet.getBattle() != null) continue;
2391                                
2392                                if (fleet.getFaction() != market.getFaction()) continue;
2393                                if (fleet.getFleetData().getNumMembers() <= 0) continue;
2394                                
2395                                float dist = Misc.getDistance(entity.getLocation(), fleet.getLocation());
2396                                dist -= entity.getRadius();
2397                                dist -= fleet.getRadius();
2398                                
2399                                if (dist < Misc.getBattleJoinRange() ) {
2400                                        if (dist < minDist) {
2401                                                best = fleet;
2402                                                minDist = dist;
2403                                        }
2404                                }
2405                        }
2406                        primary = best;
2407                } else {
2408                        //primary.setLocation(entity.getLocation().x, entity.getLocation().y);
2409                }
2410                return primary;
2411        }

2413        public static enum StationState {
2414                NONE,
2415                OPERATIONAL,
2416                UNDER_CONSTRUCTION,
2417                REPAIRS
2418        }
2419        
2420        protected StationState getStationState() {
2421                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = Misc.getStationFleet(market);
2422                boolean destroyed = false;
2423                if (fleet == null) {
2424                        fleet = Misc.getStationBaseFleet(market);
2425                        if (fleet != null) {
2426                                destroyed = true;
2427                        }
2428                }
2429                
2430                if (fleet == null) return StationState.NONE;
2431                
2432                MarketAPI market = Misc.getStationMarket(fleet);
2433                if (market != null) {
2434                        for (Industry ind : market.getIndustries()) {
2435                                if (ind.getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_STATION)) {
2436                                        if (ind.isBuilding() && !ind.isDisrupted() && !ind.isUpgrading()) {
2437                                                return StationState.UNDER_CONSTRUCTION;
2438                                        }
2439                                }
2440                        }
2441                }
2442                
2443                if (destroyed) return StationState.REPAIRS;
2444                
2445                return StationState.OPERATIONAL;
2446        }

2449        public static int applyRaidStabiltyPenalty(MarketAPI target, String desc, float re) {
2450                int penalty = 0;
2451                if (re >= 0.79f) penalty = 3;
2452                else if (re >= 0.59f) penalty = 2;
2453                else if (re >= 0.29f) penalty = 1;
2454                if (penalty > 0) {
2455                        RecentUnrest.get(target).add(penalty, desc);
2456                }
2457                return penalty;
2458        }
2459        
2460        public static int applyRaidStabiltyPenalty(MarketAPI target, String desc, float re, float maxPenalty) {
2461                int penalty = Math.round((0.45f + maxPenalty) * re);
2462                if (penalty > 0) {
2463                        RecentUnrest.get(target).add(penalty, desc);
2464                }
2465                return penalty;
2466        }

2469        public static StatModValueGetter statPrinter(final boolean withNegative) {
2470                return new StatModValueGetter() {
2471                        public String getPercentValue(StatMod mod) {
2472                                String prefix = mod.getValue() > 0 ? "+" : "";
2473                                return prefix + (int)(mod.getValue()) + "%";
2474                        }
2475                        public String getMultValue(StatMod mod) {
2476                                return Strings.X + "" + Misc.getRoundedValue(mod.getValue());
2477                        }
2478                        public String getFlatValue(StatMod mod) {
2479                                String prefix = mod.getValue() > 0 ? "+" : "";
2480                                return prefix + (int)(mod.getValue()) + "";
2481                        }
2482                        public Color getModColor(StatMod mod) {
2483                                if (withNegative && mod.getValue() < 1f) return Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
2484                                return null;
2485                        }
2486                };
2487        }

2490        public static int getBombardmentCost(MarketAPI market, CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
2491                float str = getDefenderStr(market, true);
2492                int result = (int) (str * Global.getSettings().getFloat("bombardFuelFraction"));
2493                if (result < 2) result = 2;
2494                if (fleet != null) {
2495                        float bomardBonus = Misc.getFleetwideTotalMod(fleet, Stats.FLEET_BOMBARD_COST_REDUCTION, 0f);
2496                        result -= bomardBonus;
2497                        if (result < 0) result = 0;
2498                }
2499                return result;
2500        }

3036        protected boolean checkDebtEffect() {
3037                String key = "$debt_effectTimeout";
3038                if (Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains(key)) return false;
3039                
3040                //if (true) return true;
3041                
3042                // can't exactly melt away in that small an outpost, not that it's outright desertion
3043                // but it's also not a great place to leave the fleet
3044                if (market.isPlayerOwned() && market.getSize() <= 3) return false;
3045                
3046                MonthlyReport report = SharedData.getData().getPreviousReport();
3047                
3048                
3049                // require 2 months of debt in a row
3050                if (report.getPreviousDebt() <= 0 || report.getDebt() <= 0) return false;
3051                
3052                float debt = report.getDebt() + report.getPreviousDebt();
3053                float income = report.getRoot().totalIncome;
3054                if (income < 1) income = 1;
3055                
3056                float f = debt / income;
3057                if (f > 1) f = 1;
3058                if (f < 0) f = 0;
3059                // don't penalize minor shortfalls
3060                if (f < 0.1f) return false;
3061                
3062                // and don't reduce crew below a certain minimum
3063                int crew = playerFleet.getCargo().getCrew();
3064                int marines = playerFleet.getCargo().getMarines();
3065                if (crew <= 10 && marines <= 10) return false;
3066                
3067                return true;
3068        }
3069        
3070        protected void applyDebtEffect() {
3071                
3072                MonthlyReport report = SharedData.getData().getPreviousReport();
3073                float debt = report.getDebt() + report.getPreviousDebt();
3074                float income = report.getRoot().totalIncome;
3075                if (income < 1) income = 1;
3076                
3077                float f = debt / income;
3078                if (f > 1) f = 1;
3079                if (f < 0) f = 0;
3080                
3081                int crew = playerFleet.getCargo().getCrew();
3082                int marines = playerFleet.getCargo().getMarines();
3083                
3084                float maxLossFraction = 0.03f + Math.min(f + 0.05f, 0.2f) * (float) Math.random();
3085                float marineLossFraction = 0.03f + Math.min(f + 0.05f, 0.2f) * (float) Math.random();
3086                
3087                
3088                int crewLoss = (int) (crew * maxLossFraction);
3089                if (crewLoss < 2) crewLoss = 2;
3090                
3091                int marineLoss = (int) (marines * marineLossFraction);
3092                if (marineLoss < 2) marineLoss = 2;
3093                
3094                dialog.getVisualPanel().showImagePortion("illustrations", "crew_leaving", 640, 400, 0, 0, 480, 300);
3095                
3096                text.addPara("The lack of consistent pay over the last few months has caused discontent among your crew. " +
3097                                "A number take this opportunity to leave your employment.");
3098                
3099                if (crewLoss < crew) {
3100                        playerFleet.getCargo().removeCrew(crewLoss);
3101                        AddRemoveCommodity.addCommodityLossText(Commodities.CREW, crewLoss, text);
3102                }
3103                if (marineLoss <= marines) {
3104                        playerFleet.getCargo().removeMarines(marineLoss);
3105                        AddRemoveCommodity.addCommodityLossText(Commodities.MARINES, marineLoss, text);
3106                }
3107                
3108                String key = "$debt_effectTimeout";
3109                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(key, true, 30f + (float) Math.random() * 10f);
3110                
3111                options.clearOptions();
3112                options.addOption("Continue", DEBT_RESULT_CONTINUE);
3113        }

3144        public boolean doIndustryRaid(FactionAPI faction, float attackerStr, Industry industry, float durMult) {
3145                temp.raidType = RaidType.DISRUPT;
3146                temp.target = industry;
3147                
3148                StatBonus defenderBase = new StatBonus(); 
3149                
3150                StatBonus defender = market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.GROUND_DEFENSES_MOD);
3151                String increasedDefensesKey = "core_addedDefStr";
3152                float added = getDefenderIncreaseValue(market);
3153                if (added > 0) {
3154                        defender.modifyFlat(increasedDefensesKey, added, "Increased defender preparedness");
3155                }
3156                float defenderStr = (int) Math.round(defender.computeEffective(defenderBase.computeEffective(0f)));
3157                defender.unmodifyFlat(increasedDefensesKey);
3158                
3159                temp.attackerStr = attackerStr;
3160                temp.defenderStr = defenderStr;
3161                
3162                boolean hasForces = true;
3163                boolean canDisrupt = true;
3164                temp.raidMult = attackerStr / Math.max(1f, (attackerStr + defenderStr));
3165                temp.raidMult = Math.round(temp.raidMult * 100f) / 100f;
3166                
3167                if (temp.raidMult < VALUABLES_THRESHOLD) {
3168                        hasForces = false;
3169                }
3170                if (temp.raidMult < DISRUPTION_THRESHOLD) {
3171                        canDisrupt = false;
3172                }
3173                if (!canDisrupt) return false;
3174                
3175                
3176                Random random = getRandom();
3177                
3178                applyDefenderIncreaseFromRaid(market);
3179                
3180                String reason = faction.getDisplayName() + " raid";
3181                if (faction.getPersonNamePrefix() != null) {
3182                        reason = Misc.ucFirst(faction.getPersonNamePrefix()) + " raid";
3183                }
3184                
3185                applyRaidStabiltyPenalty(market, reason, temp.raidMult);
3186                Misc.setFlagWithReason(market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate(), MemFlags.RECENTLY_RAIDED, 
3187                                                           faction.getId(), true, 30f);
3188                Misc.setRaidedTimestamp(market);
3189                
3190                if (temp.target != null) {
3191                        float dur = computeBaseDisruptDuration(temp.target);
3192                        dur *= StarSystemGenerator.getNormalRandom(random, 1f, 1.25f);
3193                        dur *= durMult;
3194                        if (dur < 2) dur = 2;
3195                        float already = temp.target.getDisruptedDays();
3196                        temp.target.setDisrupted(already + dur);
3197                }
3198                
3199                return true;
3200        }

3285        public static class BombardmentAnimation implements EveryFrameScript {
3286                public BombardmentAnimation(int num, SectorEntityToken target) {
3287                        this.num = num;
3288                        this.target = target;
3289                }
3290                int num = 0;
3291                SectorEntityToken target;
3292                int added = 0;
3293                float elapsed = 0;
3294                public boolean runWhilePaused() {
3295                        return false;
3296                }
3297                public boolean isDone() {
3298                        return added >= num;
3299                }
3300                public void advance(float amount) {
3301                        elapsed += amount * (float) Math.random();
3302                        if (elapsed < 0.03f) return;
3303                        
3304                        elapsed = 0f;
3305                        
3306                        int curr = (int) Math.round(Math.random() * 4);
3307                        if (curr < 1) curr = 0;
3308                        
3309                        Color color = new Color(255, 165, 100, 255);
3310                        
3311                        Vector2f vel = new Vector2f();
3312                        
3313                        if (target.getOrbit() != null && 
3314                                        target.getCircularOrbitRadius() > 0 && 
3315                                        target.getCircularOrbitPeriod() > 0 && 
3316                                        target.getOrbitFocus() != null) {
3317                                float circumference = 2f * (float) Math.PI * target.getCircularOrbitRadius();
3318                                float speed = circumference / target.getCircularOrbitPeriod();
3319                                
3320                                float dir = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(target.getLocation(), target.getOrbitFocus().getLocation()) + 90f;
3321                                vel = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(dir);
3322                                vel.scale(speed / Global.getSector().getClock().getSecondsPerDay());
3323                        }
3324                        
3325                        for (int i = 0; i < curr; i++) {
3326                                float glowSize = 50f + 50f * (float) Math.random();
3327                                float angle = (float) Math.random() * 360f;
3328                                float dist = (float) Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * target.getRadius();
3329                                
3330                                float factor = 0.5f + 0.5f * (1f - (float)Math.sqrt(dist / target.getRadius()));;
3331                                glowSize *= factor;
3332                                Vector2f loc = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle);
3333                                loc.scale(dist);
3334                                Vector2f.add(loc, target.getLocation(), loc);
3335                                
3336                                Color c2 = Misc.scaleColor(color, factor);
3337                                //c2 = color;
3338                                Misc.addHitGlow(target.getContainingLocation(), loc, vel, glowSize, c2);
3339                                added++;
3340                                
3341                                if (i == 0) {
3342                                        dist = Misc.getDistance(loc, Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getLocation());
3343                                        if (dist < HyperspaceTerrainPlugin.STORM_STRIKE_SOUND_RANGE) {
3344                                                float volumeMult = 1f - (dist / HyperspaceTerrainPlugin.STORM_STRIKE_SOUND_RANGE);
3345                                                volumeMult = (float) Math.sqrt(volumeMult);
3346                                                volumeMult *= 0.1f * factor;
3347                                                if (volumeMult > 0) {
3348                                                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound("mine_explosion", 1f, 1f * volumeMult, loc, Misc.ZERO);
3349                                                }
3350                                        }
3351                                }
3352                        }
3353                }
3354        }

3395                if (market.isHidden()) return false;
3396                if (market.getSize() <= 3) return false;
3397                
3398                List<OfficerDataAPI> mercs = Misc.getMercs(playerFleet);
3399                if (mercs.isEmpty()) return false;
3400                
3401                MonthlyReport report = SharedData.getData().getPreviousReport();
3402                boolean debt = report.getDebt() > 0;
3403                
3404                float contractDur = Global.getSettings().getFloat("officerMercContractDur");
3405                
3406                for (OfficerDataAPI od : mercs) {
3407                        if (debt && od.getPerson().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains(key)) {
3408                                continue;
3409                        }
3410                        float elapsed = Misc.getMercDaysSinceHired(od.getPerson());
3411                        
3412                        if (elapsed > contractDur || (debt && elapsed > 45f)) { // make sure the merc was hired long enough to have seen the debt
3413                                dialog.getInteractionTarget().setActivePerson(od.getPerson());
3414                                //dialog.getVisualPanel().showPersonInfo(getPerson(), true);
3415                                ((RuleBasedInteractionDialogPluginImpl)dialog.getPlugin()).notifyActivePersonChanged();
3416                                return true;
3417                        }
3418                }
3419                
3420                return false;
3421        }
3422        
3423        protected void convinceMercToStay() {
3424                PersonAPI merc = dialog.getInteractionTarget().getActivePerson();
3425                dialog.getInteractionTarget().setActivePerson(null);
3426                
3427                if (merc != null) {
3428                        Misc.setMercHiredNow(merc);
3429                        
3430                        String key = "$mercs_leaveTimeout";
3431                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(key, true, 5f + (float) Math.random() * 5f);
3432                        merc.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(key, true, 35f + (float) Math.random() * 5f);
3433                }
3434                
3435        }
3436        
3437        protected void mercLeaves() {
3438                PersonAPI merc = dialog.getInteractionTarget().getActivePerson();
3439                dialog.getInteractionTarget().setActivePerson(null);
3440                
3441                if (merc != null) {
3442                        FleetMemberAPI member = playerFleet.getFleetData().getMemberWithCaptain(merc);
3443                        if (member != null) {
3444                                member.setCaptain(null);
3445                        }
3446                        playerFleet.getFleetData().removeOfficer(merc);
3447                        
3448                        AddRemoveCommodity.addOfficerLossText(merc, text);
3449                        
3450                        String key = "$mercs_leaveTimeout";
3451                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(key, true, 5f + (float) Math.random() * 5f);
3452                }
3453        }
3454
3455}
